name: Board Tidy
description: Keeps the Sessions board to current work: archives sessions that are Complete and idle for 3 days, have no phase and are idle for 14 days, or sit in planning, validating or implementing for 30 days, once an hour, in every project except the kept ones (chat-style projects where every old chat stays). Pinned, running and worktree sessions stay. Nothing is deleted: Unarchive in the Archived view brings a session back, and Claude can undo the last run, unarchive a whole project, or archive one project by age on request.
author: Local
